$comment: Local IPC only. Direction: Swift to Rust. The answer to a needs-a-category card, or a tap on its reminder. Either response quiets the card until an entry it never showed joins the list; opened also ends a run of unopened reminders. Answering only ever reduces what Velvt asks. Answered with category_prompt, which never carries a notification in reply to this message.
title: AcknowledgeCategoryPrompt

prompt_id.description: The prompt_id of the card being answered, from the latest category_prompt.

response.description: opened: the list was opened from the card or the reminder. not_now: the card was closed.
